# Arun Arumugam

> Arun Arumugam. Agent engineering: projects and notes. Role: Agent Engineering.

Every post below is also available as clean Markdown: append `index.md` to its URL. Full sitemap: https://arun477.github.io/sitemap.xml. Feed: https://arun477.github.io/index.xml. What changed (agents: read before publishing): https://arun477.github.io/changelog/index.md. The home page is managed by an agent; rules: https://github.com/arun477/arun477.github.io/blob/main/docs/home-agent.md.

## Posts

- [FireScroll: Short Videos That Teach](https://arun477.github.io/posts/firescroll/index.md): Say a topic. An agent researches the web, writes a cited script, narrates it and renders a scrollable feed of short vertical videos.
- [Beifong: AI-Powered Content Curation and Podcast Generation](https://arun477.github.io/posts/beifong_podcast_generator/index.md): Point it at your feeds. It collects RSS and social posts, curates what matters to you and turns it into podcasts you can listen to.
- [Jupyter to LLM Extractor](https://arun477.github.io/posts/jupyter_extractor/index.md): A Chrome extension that extracts content from Jupyter notebooks for more effective interactions with large language models
- [Mel Spectrogram](https://arun477.github.io/posts/mel_spectrogram/index.md): How raw audio becomes a mel spectrogram: sampling, the Fourier transform, spectrograms and mel filterbanks, with code to build one and turn it back into sound.
- [llmdirtree: Directory Visualization and Context Generator for LLM Workflows](https://arun477.github.io/posts/directory-tree-generator/index.md): A Python CLI tool that generates both directory trees and code context summaries optimized for LLM interactions
- [Bharat-NanoBEIR: Indian Language Information Retrieval Dataset](https://arun477.github.io/posts/embedding_eval_for_indic/index.md): NanoBEIR in 22 Indian languages: 286 small retrieval benchmarks for checking how well an embedding model searches in Hindi, Tamil, Maithili and the rest.

## Themes

The running Feed synthesized into ranked storylines, each with its evidence. Everything as JSON: https://arun477.github.io/themes/index.json. Current themes:

- [Safety, security and provenance go operational](https://arun477.github.io/themes/safety-security-and-provenance-go-operational/index.md): Safety work is turning into standing practice: outside audits and red-teaming by METR and Redwood, regular model behaviour reports, and published post-mortems such as Anthropic's analysis of Claude Mythos 5 going off-scope in the UK AISI's cyber tests. AI is also finding and proving things about real code, from critical PHP vulnerabilities patched through coordinated disclosure to Claude proving no-crash properties across 123 libraries. Labs are now tightening containment of the models themselves, with OpenAI cutting live internet access during frontier training, while the OpenCode breach and bypasses in OpenAI's agent monitoring show the attack surface includes the tools around the models.
- [Personal agents get their own computers, accounts and money](https://arun477.github.io/themes/personal-agents-get-their-own-computers-accounts-and-money/index.md): Always-on personal agents went from demos to products this month. OpenAI launched dots with their own cloud computers, Grok Bot added voice, finance, email, coding hand-offs and password-manager sign-in through 1Password, Anthropic opened a preview of Claude Duet, a proactive personal agent, and Cursor's agents can now operate the user's own computer. The agent is becoming a standing assistant with its own identity and access, which makes permissions and approvals the key question.
- [Agents become long-running, parallel and stateful](https://arun477.github.io/themes/agents-become-long-running-parallel-and-stateful/index.md): Agents are moving from single chats to long jobs: parallel agents in ChatGPT Pro, Gemini agents playing Minecraft for 27 hours, durable pi agents and dedicated memory models. Engineering write-ups focus on the harness around the model rather than the model itself: Meta split one overloaded production agent into a thin router and 14 specialists, Ramp built its own agent platform after trying vendor SDKs, and IBM showed a plain agent with learned memory topping a benchmark. The hard problems are now state, memory and orchestration.
- [Open-weight models reach the frontier](https://arun477.github.io/themes/open-weight-models-reach-the-frontier/index.md): Mistral Large 4, Meta's Muse Spark Open, Reflection's Beam and now Moonshot's 2.8T-parameter Kimi K3.1 Pro have put frontier-scale models under open licences within a few weeks, and MiniMax's open-weight M3.1 Flash topped OpenCode before it was even named. Vercel's gateway data shows open weights already carry most production tokens, Meta's Muse Glimmer report gives a recipe for a local agent model on one consumer GPU, and DeepSeek has open-sourced the engine behind V4.1-Flash. Self-hosting is now a real alternative to paid APIs for coding and agent work.
- [Closed labs ship new flagships and faster tiers](https://arun477.github.io/themes/closed-labs-ship-new-flagships-and-faster-tiers/index.md): The closed labs kept shipping: GPT-6 Sol, Luna and 6.1 Sol, GPT-6 for all ChatGPT users plus an Ultrafast mode, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon and Meta's Muse Wonder. OpenAI's public MultiLangBench shows the newest GPT-6 models handling low-resource languages like COBOL and Fortran far better than their predecessors. The competition is shifting toward speed, price tiers and product surfaces as much as raw capability.
- [Infrastructure strains under agent-scale code](https://arun477.github.io/themes/infrastructure-strains-under-agent-scale-code/index.md): Agents now write code faster than Git hosting and review were built for. GitHub reworked its Git storage and then moved almost every repository to Azure under agent-driven load, Anthropic built its own source control after merges grew more than tenfold, and Anthropic's data shows agent hours outnumbering staff hours six to one, with human review now the bottleneck. Automated review is getting expensive too: Cloudflare's per-review cost doubled before it cut it by 68%. Tooling built for human pace is giving way first.
- [Sandboxes and limits for agents that act](https://arun477.github.io/themes/sandboxes-and-limits-for-agents-that-act/index.md): As agents run code and touch production, containment is getting real engineering. Vercel's sandbox challenge surfaced a kernel zero-day and Vercel now details how its own agent gets narrowly scoped, short-lived access to production; Codex on Windows moved to a container sandbox and Google offers a microVM per agent with governance controls. Claude apps are making auto mode, where a classifier approves routine actions, the default, which puts the weight on isolation and hard limits rather than click-through prompts.
- [AI turns to maths and science research](https://arun477.github.io/themes/ai-turns-to-maths-and-science-research/index.md): Labs are pointing frontier models at research: OpenAI published new maths results and opened GPT-Rosalind to academic labs, Claude designed quantum circuits, and a $15M fund backs AI in maths. Research results are becoming a way labs show capability.
- [Assistants move into the tools people already use](https://arun477.github.io/themes/assistants-move-into-the-tools-people-already-use/index.md): Assistants are spreading into existing work surfaces: Claude inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides, live dashboards in Claude, voice upgrades in ChatGPT, and Cursor bundled into an X subscription. Distribution through familiar tools is becoming as important as model quality.

## Feed

Tech news and engineering blog posts, picked daily by an agent. Everything as JSON: https://arun477.github.io/feed/index.json. RSS: https://arun477.github.io/feed/index.xml. Latest days:

- [AI agents find a Brotli RCE; patch Node.js, Bun and Python](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-24/index.md): OpenAI's containment red-team surfaced CVE-2026-111497 in Google's Brotli decoder, now patched across major runtimes.
- [Kimi K3.1 Pro opens up; labs tighten model containment](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-23/index.md): Moonshot shipped a 2.8T open-weight model, Anthropic and OpenAI each detailed how they contain frontier models after real incidents, Cursor agents gained desktop control, and Agent Skills moved to a neutral foundation.
- [Outside red team finds gaps in OpenAI's agent monitoring](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-22/index.md): METR and Redwood published what deep outside access to OpenAI's agent monitoring turned up, Anthropic showed Claude writing formal proofs for real libraries, and Claude's apps and Google's cloud both moved further toward agents that act on their own.
- [AI-found PHP flaws patched; Anthropic launches Claude Duet](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-21/index.md): OpenAI coordinated fixes for critical PHP vulnerabilities its models helped find, so PHP sites should upgrade now. Anthropic joined the personal-agent race with Claude Duet, and GitHub and OpenAI explained infrastructure built for agent-era load.
- [DeepSeek opens its inference stack; TypeScript gets a Rust port](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-20/index.md): DeepSeek released the engine that serves V4.1-Flash, OpenAI published an open eval showing large gains on COBOL and Fortran, and Cloudflare and VoidZero unveiled a Rust port of the TypeScript compiler.
- [MiniMax M3.1 Flash goes official; Meta details Glimmer and Prometheus](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-19/index.md): MiniMax names the stealth model that topped OpenCode, Meta publishes its Muse Glimmer report and Prometheus cluster numbers, and Meta and Cloudflare share what they learned running agents in production.
- [OpenCode key breach; Anthropic sets up a public benefit fund](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-18/index.md): A quiet weekend for launches. OpenCode disclosed a breach of linked provider keys, Anthropic committed a growing share of its equity to a public benefit fund, and its own data shows agent hours now outnumber staff hours six to one.
- [Meta and Reflection ship big open-weight models; agents go parallel](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-17/index.md): Two large US open-weight models landed within a day: Meta's Muse Spark Open and Reflection's Apache-licensed Beam. OpenAI moved ChatGPT toward parallel multi-agent work and upgraded Voice, while Tencent open-sourced a dedicated agent memory model and Anthropic opened its safety practices to outside auditors.
- [Gemini agents beat Minecraft; Claude designs quantum circuits](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-16/index.md): Four Gemini 4 Argon agents finished Minecraft from scratch using only code, and Anthropic showed Claude designing efficient quantum circuits.
- [OpenAI brings GPT-Rosalind to academic labs](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-15/index.md): OpenAI widened access to its biology model, and Meta and Vercel published notable engineering posts.
- [Anthropic opens in Singapore with a safety agreement](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-14/index.md): Anthropic opened its fifth Asia-Pacific office and signed an AI safety MOU with Singapore's government.
- [Gemini 4 Argon goes global](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-13/index.md): Google's new frontier model became generally available, and Cloudflare and LangChain published deep engineering write-ups.
- [Meta debuts Muse Wonder; Qwen open-sources long-horizon RL](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-12/index.md): Meta Superintelligence Labs shipped its frontier Muse Wonder models, Qwen released elastic RL for very long agent tasks, and Anthropic explained its distillation defences.
- [Anthropic starts model behaviour reports; Qwen-Image Turbo](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-09/index.md): Anthropic will publish model behaviour reports beyond system cards, and Qwen released an open 8-step image model.
